name: Procedural Cave Generation
definition: A subtractive procedural method using a particle-based approach to generate cave-like structures. A sphere is traced in a user-specified direction, with its radius decaying and direction affected by gravity and curl noise, producing negative density values to remove voxels.
summary: Procedural cave generation carves organic subsurface voids in voxel terrain via particle erosion or noise filtering, differing from base terrain creation by acting as a post-processing step for complex underground structures.
